description: Shell script for testing git checkout behaviors, including switching branches, using checkout - (the previous checkout), branch rebase, and refspecs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for the given description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the command it wraps must fail.

methods.name: test_cmp_symbolic_HEAD_ref
methods.description: Compares the current symbolic ref HEAD to an expected branch name.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two values or files for equality.
